name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation aligns with and follows the context provided. It evaluates whether the response is pertinent to the preceding conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the continuation. It checks if the response makes sense given the context and if it maintains a consistent narrative without contradictions.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the continuation to sustain or enhance the interest of the conversation. It considers if the response prompts further discussion or interaction.

name: Informativeness
description: Measures the amount of new, relevant information or insights provided in the continuation. It assesses whether the response contributes meaningful content to the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and creativity of the continuation. It evaluates whether the response introduces novel ideas or unique perspectives while remaining relevant to the context.

name: Grammar and Syntax
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness and proper use of language in the continuation. It checks for spelling mistakes, punctuation errors, and overall readability.

name: Emotional Tone Appropriateness
description: Measures how well the emotional tone of the continuation matches the context and expectations of the conversation. It evaluates whether the response conveys an appropriate emotional tone.
